common.button_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
common.footer: You received this email because this address is used for a {app_name} account. If that wasn't you, you can ignore it.

verify_email.subject: Confirm your email for {app_name}
verify_email.body: Confirm your email address to finish creating your {app_name} account. The link is valid for {hours} hours.

account_exists.subject: Sign-up attempt with your email at {app_name}
account_exists.body: Someone tried to create a new {app_name} account with this email address, but an account already exists. If it was you, sign in or reset your password. Otherwise no action is needed.

password_reset.subject: Reset your {app_name} password
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. The link is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email — your password stays the same.

password_changed.subject: Your {app_name} password was changed
password_changed.body: Your password was just changed and your other sessions were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset your password now and contact support.

subscription_ending.subject: Your {app_name} access ends on {date}
subscription_ending.body: Your {plan} access ends on {date}. Renew before then to keep your VPN connected without interruption.

subscription_expired.subject: Your {app_name} access has ended
subscription_expired.body: Your {plan} access has ended and your devices can no longer connect. You can renew at any time to reconnect.

payment_received.subject: Payment received — {app_name}
payment_received.body: Thank you! Your payment was received. Your {plan} access is active until {date}.

referral_reward.subject: Your friend joined {app_name} — {percent}% off for you
referral_reward.body: A friend you invited has bought a subscription. You get {percent}% off your next payment — it's applied automatically.

referral_reward_bonus.subject: Your friend joined {app_name} — {days} free days and {percent}% off for you
referral_reward_bonus.body: A friend you invited has bought a subscription. We've added {days} free days to your {app_name} access (now until {date}), and you get {percent}% off your next payment — it's applied automatically.
